title: Mexican Casserole with Crisp Topping
description: A flavorful and satisfying Mexican-inspired casserole with a crunchy topping made possible by the crispy ingredient.
instructions: Cook the casserole rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the diced minari chili peppers in a little oil until tender.
In a separate bowl, combine cooked rice, sautéed chili peppers, and shredded zesty cheese.
Transfer the rice mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with shredded crisp lettuce and bake for 20 minutes.
Increase oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the top is crispy.
Remove from oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Slice into squares and serve hot.
